# redirhub_link (Resource)

A link of the workspace: a short link (`short-url`), a dynamic QR code (`qr`), a domain redirect (`redirect`) or a website migration mapping (`migration`). The attributes are the fields of `/v1/links`. Short links take `host` and `alias`; redirects and migration mappings take `url`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A domain redirect.
resource "redirhub_link" "old_domain" {
  handler       = "redirect"
  url           = "old-domain.com"
  destinations  = ["https://new-domain.com"]
  type          = "301"
  forward_path  = true
  forward_query = true
}

# A website migration: one mapping per old page, kept in a CSV next to the config.
resource "redirhub_link" "migration" {
  for_each = { for row in csvdecode(file("${path.module}/redirects.csv")) : row.from => row }

  handler      = "migration"
  url          = each.value.from
  destinations = [each.value.to]
  type         = "301"
}

# A branded short link.
resource "redirhub_link" "spring" {
  handler      = "short-url"
  host         = "go.example.com"
  alias        = "spring"
  destinations = ["https://example.com/campaigns/spring"]
  utm = {
    source   = "newsletter"
    campaign = "spring"
  }
}

# A dynamic QR code, paused until the menu is printed.
resource "redirhub_link" "menu" {
  handler      = "qr"
  host         = "go.example.com"
  alias        = "menu"
  destinations = ["https://example.com/menu"]
  status       = "paused"
  qr = {
    theme = "dark"
    logo  = true
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `destinations` (List of String) Where visitors are sent, the primary destination first. More than one is shared out by `destination_routing` (plan feature).
- `handler` (String) What the link is: `short-url`, `qr`, `redirect` or `migration`. Changing it replaces the link.

### Optional

- `alias` (String) A short link's path after the host. Left out, RedirHub picks one. Changing it replaces the link.
- `description` (String) A note shown in the dashboard.
- `destination_routing` (String) How several destinations share the traffic, e.g. `random`, `weighted`, `fastest`. `GET /v1/shared/types` lists them.
- `forward_path` (Boolean) Append the requested path to the destination.
- `forward_query` (Boolean) Append the requested query string to the destination.
- `host` (String) The hostname. Set it for a short link or QR code (a short-link domain of the workspace); a redirect's comes from `url`. Changing it replaces the link.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Ask visitors for this password. The API never returns it, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected.
- `qr` (Attributes) The QR code style of a short link. A `qr` link always has one; a `short-url` link has one once it is set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--qr))
- `status` (String) `active`, or `paused` to stop serving the link.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags (plan feature).
- `title` (String) A title shown in the dashboard.
- `type` (String) The redirect type, e.g. `301`, `302`, `307`, `308`, `frame`. `GET /v1/shared/types` lists them.
- `url` (String) The URL the link answers on. Set it for a redirect or a migration mapping (`old.example.com`, `example.com/blog/*`; the scheme and a trailing slash are ignored); a short link's is `host/alias`. Changing it replaces the link.
- `utm` (Attributes) UTM parameters added to the destination. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--utm))

### Read-Only

- `https` (Boolean) Whether the link is served over HTTPS.
- `id` (String) The link id, e.g. `link_7bXmR4`.

<a id="nestedatt--qr"></a>
### Nested Schema for `qr`

Optional:

- `color` (String) The code's colour, e.g. `#181D27`.
- `logo` (Boolean) Draw the workspace logo in the middle.
- `margin` (String) The quiet zone: `s`, `m` or `l`.
- `show_url` (Boolean) Print the link under the code.
- `theme` (String) `light` or `dark`.


<a id="nestedatt--utm"></a>
### Nested Schema for `utm`

Optional:

- `campaign` (String)
- `content` (String)
- `medium` (String)
- `source` (String)
- `term` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Any link imports by the id shown in the dashboard and returned by the API.
terraform import redirhub_link.old_domain link_7bXmR4
```
